_note: Recipes for scripts/fetch_opendata.py (story MK19.4). One entry per dataset.
expect_licence is a GUARD, not documentation. The fetch aborts if the portal's
declared licence differs, so a licence change is noticed rather than silently
absorbed into a public repository. Verify terms before ever relaxing it.
Where a dataset's terms do not permit redistribution, set snapshot_prohibited
with the reason. The fetch then skips it and it stays live-fetch only.

recipes.name: Australian Road Deaths Database — Fatalities
recipes.description: Road crash fatalities in Australia by date, state, road user type and crash characteristics. Monthly series maintained by BITRE.
recipes.publisher: Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics
recipes.attribution: Source: Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics (BITRE), Australian Road Deaths Database. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia.
recipes.pii_note: Aggregate incident records with no personal identifiers. Gender and age group are present as coarse categories. Expect the privacy filter to find nothing, which is the point of including this dataset: it is the honest contrast against the synthetic fixtures where it finds everything.

recipes.name: AEMO Electricity Price and Demand
recipes.description: Half-hourly regional electricity spot price and demand for the National Electricity Market.
recipes.snapshot_prohibited: AEMO data is published under AEMO's own terms of use rather than an open licence, and redistribution may be restricted. Until those terms have been read and confirmed, this dataset is live-fetch only with no committed snapshot. Do not remove this flag without recording who verified the terms and when.
